Sydenham School
Sydenham School is a vibrant school community and one in which we place a strong emphasis on the quality of relationships across the school. We have high standards and high expectations in the belief that every student can perform highly. We are an inclusive, comprehensive school rooted in the heart of the local community. The school is united by a set of core values that include hard work (endeavour), creativity, open mindedness and kindness...
The curriculum is aligned to the school vision and aims which are underpinned by the High Performance Learning Philosophy.
Welcome to SFH6, the joint Sixth Form of Sydenham and Forest Hill: two successful and popular schools working together in Post 16 education since the early 1970s.
Sydenham has a long tradition of educating girls, often pioneering innovation and development.

Sydenham School
Headteacher's Welcome
Sydenham School is a successful, diverse and inclusive girls' community secondary school with a co-educational sixth form, established in 1917. We provide a nurturing environment for students to feel safe, confident, happy and achieve academic excellence.
Our motto "Aim High" reflects our commitment to instilling the Sydenham Characteristics of ambition, determination and respect. We encourage ambitious goal-setting, exploration of passions, resilience-building, self-respect, respect for others and developing empathy. Students are equipped with the grit to persist through challenges and reach desired outcomes.
Our curriculum is designed to not only fulfil the requirements of the national curriculum but also go beyond it. This approach aims to instil a genuine passion for learning in every subject among our students. Our teachers believe that by ensuring students enjoy learning they will also want to dig deeper, explore further and develop their own interest and motivation to learn more. We celebrate each subject’s discipline, its creativity, the use of active learning, problem solving and collaboration in the classroom so that our students know more, remember more and become more confident and engaged. As an inclusive school we are proud of the results of all our students and believe that every student can achieve highly regardless of their starting points.
We have extensive extracurricular opportunities that enrich students’ experiences and unlock their potential through clubs, trips, sports and programs such as the Duke of Edinburgh's Award. These build excitement, engagement, confidence, friendships and enable risk-taking and learning to overcoming challenges. We nurture leadership skills by providing platforms like the School Council, Sports Leaders, Debate Mate and Student Leadership roles for active community/global citizenship.
Local and national partnerships with SSAT, Best Practice Network, Royal Academy of Arts, Lawn Tennis Association and the Rugby Football Union, expose students and staff to best practices. As a teaching hub, we lead the way in early career teacher training, ensuring access to the latest educational developments.
Our thriving SFH6 sixth form offers an extensive range of A Levels and vocational Level 3 courses. We take immense pride in our sixth form results and the breadth of destinations to which our students progress. Our careers, university and Oxbridge preparation programme ambitiously supports applications to the most competitive universities, while respecting each individual's aspirations and the myriad options for undergraduate study and direct workplace entry.
Our holistic approach develops well-rounded, articulate individuals prepared to make positive societal contributions in their communities and beyond.

Sydenham School
About Us
Dear Sydenham Alumna,
Whether you left Sydenham last year or many decades ago, you remain an important part of our school community. Since 1917, Sydenham School has been educating and empowering young women, and you are part of that proud legacy.
Our motto "Aim High" continues to guide everything we do. Today's students, like you once did, embody the Sydenham Characteristics of ambition, determination and respect as they pursue their goals and passions. We remain committed to providing a nurturing environment where every student feels safe, confident and happy to achieve academic excellence.
Our curriculum still goes beyond the national curriculum requirements, instilling a genuine passion for learning in every subject. We celebrate creativity, active learning, problem solving and collaboration in the classroom so that our students know more, remember more and become more confident and engaged. As an inclusive school, we are proud that every student can achieve highly regardless of their starting point – a principle that has defined Sydenham throughout our history.
The extensive extracurricular opportunities you may remember – clubs, trips, sports programmes and the Duke of Edinburgh's Award – continue to enrich students' experiences and unlock their potential. We nurture leadership skills through platforms like the School Council, Sports Leaders, Debate Mate and Student Leadership roles, preparing active community and global citizens.
Our thriving SFH6 sixth form, now co-educational, offers an extensive range of A Levels and vocational Level 3 courses. We take immense pride in our sixth form results and the breadth of destinations to which our students progress, from the most competitive universities to apprenticeships and direct workplace entry.
Just as Sydenham prepared you to make positive contributions to society, we continue to develop well-rounded, articulate individuals ready to make their mark on their communities and the wider world.
We would love to hear about your journey since leaving Sydenham and welcome you to reconnect with your school.
Emma Wijnberg Headteacher
